assessment.body:
Friday 6:30 PM IST. The worst week in months ends on a sour note — but one significant back-channel signal.

THE WEEK IN NUMBERS
• Sensex: 79,273 (Monday) → 76,681 (Friday close) = -2,592 pts (-3.3%)
• Three consecutive daily losses: -757 (Wed) → -853 (Thu) → -983 (Fri)
• Nifty IT: -5% Friday alone. Infosys: -7% to Rs 1,154.60
• Brent: $107.25 Friday. Up from $95 just one week ago
• BSE market cap lost ~Rs 16L Cr in three days

THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT SIGNAL — BLOOMBERG BACK-CHANNEL
• Bloomberg (via Business Standard live): Iranian officials discussed ceasefire with Pakistan
• First confirmed positive diplomatic signal since Iran rejected Islamabad round two
• Iran's diplomatic wing is testing the ground through Pakistan's mediation channel
• This does NOT mean Iran submitted a unified proposal
• But it means Iran has NOT completely slammed the door
• The partial market recovery from Nifty intraday low of 23,813 to close at 23,897 reflects this signal

THE STRUCTURAL EXPLANATION — MOJTABA INCAPACITATED
• NYT (four Iranian officials via News24): Mojtaba Khamenei had hand surgery, facial burns, difficulty speaking
• He cannot easily convene internal power broker meetings needed to unify Iran's position
• IRGC is effectively running war policy in the vacuum
• This explains why Iran cannot produce a "unified proposal" — its decision-maker is physically unable
• Recovery timeline: estimated 1-2 weeks (hand surgery + facial burns)
• Deal timeline now linked to Mojtaba's recovery, not just diplomatic will

THE MARKET DAMAGE
• Nifty 24,000 flipped from support to resistance — key level for next week
• IT sector structural concerns separate from war: AI disruption + 2-4% dollar revenue growth pre-war
• Nifty IT approaching 30-month lows
• Recovery stocks: Cochin Shipyard (+7%), Coal India (+1.85%), Consumer staples

INDIA's NEXT WEEK RISK MATRIX
• Iran deadline ~April 25-27 expires this weekend
• Bloomberg back-channel = Iran may be preparing a partial proposal
• Mojtaba recovery = wild card
• OMC hike: near-certain within days at $107 Brent
• Nifty 23,600 = next support if no diplomatic signal
• Nifty 24,300-24,600 = recovery target if proposal submitted

VERDICT: Week 8 of the West Asia War ends with India's market at its worst since the war began, Brent at $107, and a new explanation for why the diplomatic impasse has lasted so long — Iran's new Supreme Leader is physically unable to chair the internal meetings needed to unify Tehran around a proposal. The Bloomberg back-channel signal is real but thin. The weekend will determine whether the back-channel produces a formal proposal or whether the shoot-to-kill order produces a naval incident that opens next week with fresh chaos.
